system.description:
Transfigured Technique – Transfiguration.

Transfiguration is treated as a Physical Condition.

A Transfigured creature suffers one of following effects based on the chosen designation. This cannot be changed, for its duration, unless the creature is Transfigured again.

Avian. A transfigured (Avian) creature loses bone density and weight. They make saving throws and checks to resist being moved against their will, knocked prone or Dazed with a -2 penalty.

Carnivoran. A transfigured (Carnivoran) creature loses their ability to defend themselves effectively, suffering a -2 penalty to their Dexterity and Constitution saving throws.

Herbivore. A transfigured (Herbivore) creature loses their ability fight effectively, suffering a penalty to the damage they deal, reducing the number of dice they roll for damage by 1.

Insectoid. A transfigured (Insectoid) creature loses their ability to avoid encounters. They cannot cast jutsu with a Casting time of Reaction that grants a bonus to their Saving throws or AC.

Chimeric Mutation – Transfiguration (Medical Domain: Transmuted)

Penalty Options

Aberration. A transfigured (Aberration) creature suffers disadvantage on all checks relying on any of their 5 senses and they cannot benefit from jutsu based bonuses.

Demonic. A transfigured (Demonic) creature becomes unstable, the first time each turn they take damage, they must make a Constitution saving throw vs the Medical-Nin’s Ninjutsu save DC, being Dazed on a failed save.

Monstrosity. A transfigured (Monstrosity) creature loses control of their own bodily functions wanting to attack everything around it. If more than 1 creature is within 10 feet of it, it suffers a -1 penalty to hit for every creature within 10 feet of it.

Transmogrified Biology – Transfiguration

Penalty Options

Sage Beast. A transfigured (Sage Beast) creature suffers uncontrollable chakra overflow and physical instability.

At the beginning of a transfigured creatures turn, they take necrotic damage equal to the Medical Nin’s Channeled Healing bonus as their cellular structure continues to break down.

When the affected creature casts a jutsu, they must roll a d20. On a roll of 5 or more, they jutsu cast has its cost increased by an amount equal to the Medical Nin’s Channeled Healing bonus.
system.summary: One designation: Avian (−2 vs forced movement, Prone, Dazed), Carnivoran (−2 Dex and Con saves), Herbivore (one fewer damage die), Insectoid (no defensive reactions); with Chimeric Mutation also Aberration (disadvantage on sense checks, no jutsu bonuses), Demonic (Con save or Dazed when first damaged each turn), Monstrosity (−1 to hit per creature within 10 ft); with Transmogrified Biology also Sage Beast (necrotic damage each turn, jutsu cost d20 roll).

rules.text: Pick the designation when it is applied (it can't change unless Transfigured again): Avian, Carnivoran, Herbivore or Insectoid; Aberration, Demonic or Monstrosity with Chimeric Mutation; Sage Beast with Transmogrified Biology. Its effect is applied at the table.
